title: The Wandering Trader
description:
The Wandering Trader is your source for new breeding stock and rare crafting ingredients. He can be summoned by ringing any Copper Bell, though he has a cooldown of 1 Minecraft day between summons. Natural Wandering Trader spawns are also still enabled.

Each Trader will have a random selection of animals and one special crafting ingredient for sale.

Note: Spawn Eggs purchased from the Trader do not automatically tame an animal upon use. Animals spawned from a Spawn Egg are considered wild and eligible for despawn until you tame them, just like in Vanilla. Make sure you have the right food on hand before throwing that Egg!
